description: v2.4.1 (OTA 031) - per-faction overrides for the shared hub-room layout in static_hub.json. Same room ids, same exits, same anchorNpcs (faction-neutral characters who serve all comers); only `name`, `shortName`, and `description` vary per faction. Lookup via hubRoomFor(roomId, factionId) in hub.ts - falls back to the base static_hub.json entry when a faction has no override. *** OTA-1360 - THE MAP IS THE AUTHORITY FOR NAMES; THE SKIN IS THE AUTHORITY FOR PROSE. *** All fifteen rooms carry a per-faction `description` (the buried level used to serve the Reclaimers' text to a Monarch palace and a Giant shrine alike), but the buried level's NAMES are the same on every one of the nine outpost PNGs - First Landing, Second Landing, The Pump Room, Storage Halls, The Shallow Digs - so they are the same here too. Chips are the map label's own distinctive word: never a structural id ('Landing 1'), never a word absent from the label ('Cells' for The Scriptorium Dormitory), and never the generic half a sibling room shares ('Imperial' for both the Imperial Hall and the Imperial Vault). Locked by ota1360MapNames.

outpost_gate.name: The Threshold
outpost_gate.description: A vestibule of vault-stone and silent bookshelves. The Order brother at the desk marks your name in a ledger he will not show you.

outpost_central.name: The Sanctum Hall
outpost_central.description: A vaulted study under a single hanging Aetheric chandelier. A reading lectern at the center holds an open atlas, the Cradle of Dusk marked in three competing scholars' hands.

outpost_armory.name: The Reliquary Armory
outpost_armory.description: A locked vault of restored pre-flood weapons, each tagged with provenance. Irma keeps the older steel oiled and the Aether-touched blades behind silk drape.

outpost_messhall.name: The Refectory
outpost_messhall.description: Stone benches under reading-lamps. The kitchen serves whatever the Cloister's gardens grew that week; Halem keeps the table conversation thin and the bread thick.

outpost_workshop.name: The Vellum Workshop
outpost_workshop.description: Lecterns and copying-desks where the Order's scribes restore pre-flood texts. Tarek doubles as the binder; his hands are stained with ink and Aether-resin.

outpost_quarters.name: The Scriptorium Dormitory
outpost_quarters.description: Narrow cells off a shared corridor, each with a desk and a candle. The Order sleeps in shifts so the reading-rooms are never empty.

outpost_lab.name: The High Reading Room
outpost_lab.description: Where the Order's senior scholars work. Glass cabinets of pre-flood manuscripts, an Aether-stabilized desk, and Jorah at the heart of it with a footnote in hand.

outpost_relic_vault.name: The Sealed Archive
outpost_relic_vault.description: Mechanical locks behind a sigil-marked door. The Order's most sensitive recovered texts wait inside, untranslated by deliberate policy.

outpost_chapel.name: The Reading Cell
outpost_chapel.description: A small room with a single bench, a single book, and a single Aether-lamp. The Order's scholars come here when a passage needs to be argued with in silence.

outpost_culvert_descent.name: The Archive Descent
outpost_culvert_descent.description: Stone stairs to the deeper archive levels. The Order's oldest texts live below; the air is dry by Aetheric design and the light is rationed.

buried_landing_one.name: First Landing
buried_landing_one.description: A wide platform of cracked Tartarian stone, and the point where the Order stops replacing the lamps. The stair behind you climbs north to the threshold; ahead it keeps dropping south, and the brothers' ledger has no entry for what is down there.

buried_landing_two.name: Second Landing
buried_landing_two.description: Where the Order's own maps end, and are honest about it. Pumps west, the sealed stores east, the cuts south, the stair back north. A brother has chalked a question mark on the south wall and initialled it; nobody has rubbed it out.

buried_pumps.name: The Pump Room
buried_pumps.description: Old Aetheric pumps churn the silt-water out of the lower levels, and have run since before the Order kept records of them. A reading-desk has been dragged in and bolted down: someone takes their measure every week and files it where you will not see. The only corridor runs back east to the junction.

buried_storage.name: Storage Halls
buried_storage.description: Tartarian crates the Order has catalogued and not opened, each with a brass tag and a date. The mud-glass containers in the back row are old enough to be their own field of study. One corridor, back west to the junction.

buried_shallow_digs.name: The Shallow Digs
buried_shallow_digs.description: The Order does not dig for salvage; it digs for text. Tarpaulins, rationed lamps, a cut opened into mud-glass strata where the Aetheric pulse is loud enough to hear with your teeth. Two brothers sit at it in shifts, writing down what they hear. The way out is north, the way you came.

outpost_gate.name: The Atrium
outpost_gate.description: Polished mud-glass tiles and a carved Monarch sigil over the doorway. The seneschal nods you through without speaking — your business has already been logged elsewhere.

outpost_central.name: The Court of Standards
outpost_central.description: A flagstone court ringed with the standards of every Lost Capital. A Monarch banner hangs over the central plinth where a cracked map-stone has been re-carved twice.

outpost_armory.name: The Court Arsenal
outpost_armory.description: Display racks of dress-blades over working weapons of dynastic make. Irma serves the Monarchs in steel as much as in silver; she does not ask what's about to be used.

outpost_messhall.name: The Banquet Floor
outpost_messhall.description: A long table laid with mismatched silver — half pre-flood, half common. Halem serves what the Monarchs allow themselves; the kitchen is always five courses behind the proper ones.

outpost_workshop.name: The Cabinet Workshop
outpost_workshop.description: An immaculate room of polished tools and dynastic technicians. Tarek serves the Monarchs as their relic-repairer — the older the artifact, the higher up the request came from.

outpost_quarters.name: The Retainers' Quarters
outpost_quarters.description: Curtained alcoves with dynastic seals over each cot. A spare bunk in the corner is set aside for any Monarch agent who needs ground for the night.

outpost_lab.name: The Cabinet of Curiosities
outpost_lab.description: The Monarchs' private collection of suppressed Tartarian artifacts. Jorah catalogs each piece for the family that owns it; nothing leaves these shelves.

outpost_relic_vault.name: The Royal Strongroom
outpost_relic_vault.description: A vault behind two heavy doors, both keyed to the Monarchs' inner circle. The shelves hold what the family wants the world to never see again.

outpost_chapel.name: The Family Chapel
outpost_chapel.description: A small room with portraits of dead Monarchs and a single lit candle. Family business is conducted here when nothing else is appropriate.

outpost_culvert_descent.name: The Sub-Court Descent
outpost_culvert_descent.description: Polished mud-glass stairs to the family's private levels. Only Monarchs and their named retainers descend; the door at the bottom is keyed to dynastic blood.

buried_landing_one.name: First Landing
buried_landing_one.description: A wide platform of cracked Tartarian stone with its mud-glass facing stripped off long ago and never replaced — the Monarchs finish what guests can see. The stair behind you climbs north to the Atrium; ahead it keeps dropping south into the dark.

buried_landing_two.name: Second Landing
buried_landing_two.description: Where the household's writ stops. Pumps west, the disused cellars east, the cuts south, the stair back north. A seneschal's notice is nailed to the wall declaring the south corridor no concern of the family, dated the year two retainers went down it.

buried_pumps.name: The Pump Room
buried_pumps.description: Old Aetheric pumps churn the silt-water out from under the Court. They have run for centuries and no Monarch ever ordered it — a household that would notice the day they stopped and cannot say who keeps them running. The only corridor runs back east to the junction.

buried_storage.name: Storage Halls
buried_storage.description: Tartarian crates under a Monarch seal that predates the current line, most rotted through, some intact. The mud-glass containers in the back row are old enough to count as artifacts, which is exactly why they are down here and not on display upstairs. One corridor, back west to the junction.

buried_shallow_digs.name: The Shallow Digs
buried_shallow_digs.description: The deepest ground beneath the Court that anyone has bothered to map, and the family does not put it in writing. Tarpaulins, rope ladders, braziers somebody keeps lit. The cuts open into mud-glass strata where the Aetheric pulse is loud enough to hear with your teeth. The way out is north, the way you came.

outpost_gate.name: The Threshold Stair
outpost_gate.description: A stair carved from a single block of Aether-bonded mud-stone, worn smooth by generations of bare feet. The Catacomb keeper bows you in without a word.

outpost_central.name: The Memorial Hall
outpost_central.description: An echoing chamber of bone-shelf alcoves and quiet Aether-lamps. A map-stone of the True Tartarian tunnels sits at the center, etched by hands the keepers still remember by name.

outpost_armory.name: The Forge Shrine
outpost_armory.description: An anvil shaped like a kneeling Tartarian. Irma works only with traditional methods — no Aether-shortcuts, every blade smelted from temple-stone ore.

outpost_messhall.name: The Common Hearth
outpost_messhall.description: A low circle of mud-stone benches around a central firepit. Halem stews bog-fish and root-mash the way True Tartarians have for centuries — no metal pots, only fired clay.

outpost_workshop.name: The Ancestor Workshop
outpost_workshop.description: Where True Tartarians coax old Aether-glyphs back to wakefulness. Tarek hums to each piece as he works; the hum, he insists, is half the calibration.

outpost_quarters.name: The Ancestor Bunks
outpost_quarters.description: Stone shelf-bunks cut into the wall — the same kind the Entombed once slept in. A clay basin of water sits by every bunk for ritual washing.

outpost_lab.name: The Glyph Chamber
outpost_lab.description: A room of Aetheric mud-glass tablets propped on stone easels. Jorah translates the older glyphs in candlelight — the Aether is what reads the text, not her eyes.

outpost_relic_vault.name: The Ancestor Crypt
outpost_relic_vault.description: A reverent chamber of relics in clay seals, each tagged with the name of the Tartarian who first carried it. Entry requires a True Tartarian's blessing.

outpost_chapel.name: The Ancestor Chapel
outpost_chapel.description: A room of clay urns and quiet Aether-light. Tartarians come here to speak with their Entombed; nobody asks what answers come back.

outpost_culvert_descent.name: The Catacomb Descent
outpost_culvert_descent.description: Worn stone stairs into the True Tartarian Catacombs themselves. Each step has been touched by a thousand bare feet; the air below smells of mud-glass and ancestor.

buried_landing_one.name: First Landing
buried_landing_one.description: A wide platform of cracked Tartarian stone, worn to a shine down the middle by bare feet. The stair behind you climbs north to the threshold; ahead it keeps dropping south. The keepers pause here out of habit, though none of them remembers being told to.

buried_landing_two.name: Second Landing
buried_landing_two.description: Where the walked ground ends. Pumps west, the kept halls east, the cuts south, the stair back north. The keepers have a name for every stone down to this point and no name at all for the south corridor, which is their way of saying it.

buried_pumps.name: The Pump Room
buried_pumps.description: Old Aetheric pumps draw the silt-water out from under the catacombs so that the dead stay dry. They have run for centuries. The keepers speak of them the way you speak of a lung — not maintained, simply going. The only corridor runs back east to the turning.

buried_storage.name: Storage Halls
buried_storage.description: Tartarian crates the keepers have never sold and never opened, stacked the way the last hands left them. The mud-glass containers in the back row are older than the oldest name on the shelves upstairs. One corridor, back west to the turning.

buried_shallow_digs.name: The Shallow Digs
buried_shallow_digs.description: The furthest the True Tartarians have gone beneath their own dead, and they went carefully. Rope ladders, low braziers, cloth laid over the raw stone. The cuts open into mud-glass strata where the Aetheric pulse is loud enough to hear with your teeth; the keepers call that sound an ancestor clearing their throat. The way out is north, the way you came.

outpost_gate.name: The Crown Gate
outpost_gate.description: Twin standards of the lost line flank the doorway, banners dust-grayed but unbroken. The herald nods to your bloodline before your face.

outpost_central.name: The Throne Promenade
outpost_central.description: A long colonnaded hall under a vaulted Aetheric ceiling. The map-stone at its heart shows the empire as it WAS — every district, every spire, every capital still standing.

outpost_armory.name: The Heir's Armory
outpost_armory.description: Standards lean against racks of family blades. Irma's hammer is older than the dynasty itself; she sharpens what no merchant would dare offer to royal hands.

outpost_messhall.name: The Imperial Hall
outpost_messhall.description: A long table laid with twelve covers for one diner. Halem still serves to dynastic protocol; the empty chairs are a discipline, not a sadness.

outpost_workshop.name: The Heir's Workshop
outpost_workshop.description: Restoration benches under crystal lamps. Tarek is a third-generation court tinkerer; he rebuilds dynasty-marked weapons to original tolerance.

outpost_quarters.name: The Royal Quarters
outpost_quarters.description: Curtained beds with embroidered dynastic standards. Even the empty bunks are made up; the Dynasty maintains the appearance of fullness as a discipline.

outpost_lab.name: The Library of the Line
outpost_lab.description: Dynasty genealogies on Aether-preserved scrolls, lineage walls, restored coronation records. Jorah trace-checks every claim of blood that walks through the door.

outpost_relic_vault.name: The Imperial Vault
outpost_relic_vault.description: The dynasty's confiscated treasures, returned to their proper case. The lock is mechanical and the key is hereditary.

outpost_chapel.name: The Coronation Chamber
outpost_chapel.description: A small room reserved for the dynasty's private rites. The throne in the corner is a working chair, not a relic; it is sat in only by those of the line.

outpost_culvert_descent.name: The Crypt Stair
outpost_culvert_descent.description: Carved stairs to the dynasty's lower chambers — burial vaults, archive crypts, the council room of the empty thrones.

buried_landing_one.name: First Landing
buried_landing_one.description: A wide platform of cracked Tartarian stone, the sockets of stripped standards still set in the wall. The stair behind you climbs north to the Crown Gate; ahead it keeps dropping south, past everything the empire never got around to finishing.

buried_landing_two.name: Second Landing
buried_landing_two.description: Where the imperial survey simply stops. Pumps west, the tribute stores east, the cuts south, the stair back north. The last herald to inventory this level wrote 'pending' beside the south corridor, in a hand three hundred years dead.

buried_pumps.name: The Pump Room
buried_pumps.description: Old Aetheric pumps churn the silt-water out of the lower chambers — imperial work still doing imperial duty with nobody left to bill for it. They have run for centuries. The only corridor runs back east to the junction.

buried_storage.name: Storage Halls
buried_storage.description: Tartarian crates stamped with the marks of districts that no longer exist, most rotted through, some intact. The mud-glass containers in the back row were somebody's taxes once. One corridor, back west to the junction.

buried_shallow_digs.name: The Shallow Digs
buried_shallow_digs.description: An imperial excavation that ran out of empire. Tarpaulins, rope ladders, braziers relit by whoever is posted here now. The cuts open into mud-glass strata where the Aetheric pulse is loud enough to hear with your teeth, and every survey peg still standing carries a crown. The way out is north, the way you came.

outpost_gate.name: The Reception
outpost_gate.description: A clerical office with filing cabinets and a coffee maker. The man at the desk doesn't look up from his paper — your visit is not officially happening.

outpost_central.name: The Operations Room
outpost_central.description: A windowless conference room with whiteboards along every wall. The wall map shows every Tartarian site flagged with a colored pin and a status code only the senior partners read.

outpost_armory.name: The Secured Storage
outpost_armory.description: Concealed-carry holsters, suppressed bolt-casters, and a small but immaculate Tartarian relic in a glass case 'for reference.' Irma signs each piece out as 'recovered property.'

outpost_messhall.name: The Break Room
outpost_messhall.description: A drop-ceiling room with a microwave, a coffee maker, and a kettle. Halem keeps the small talk small; the gossip that matters happens elsewhere.

outpost_workshop.name: The Lab
outpost_workshop.description: A clean-room behind a key-card door. Tarek tunes surveillance Aether-relays and the occasional 'recovery-aid' device that the surface press will never see.

outpost_quarters.name: The Safehouse Bunks
outpost_quarters.description: A row of identical bunks under fluorescent strip-lights. Each has a small lockbox bolted to the wall. Names are not used here.

outpost_lab.name: The Document Room
outpost_lab.description: A windowless office of filing cabinets and one terminal. Jorah maintains the Architects' counter-narrative: which Tartaria evidence to suppress, which to discredit, which to ignore.

outpost_relic_vault.name: The Evidence Vault
outpost_relic_vault.description: A secure room of catalogued Tartarian artifacts the Architects will spend a generation explaining away. The inventory is on paper; nothing about this room is digital.

outpost_chapel.name: The Quiet Office
outpost_chapel.description: A small office with a single chair and a single window with the blinds drawn. The Architects come here when a decision is too messy to make in committee.

outpost_culvert_descent.name: The Sublevel Access
outpost_culvert_descent.description: An unmarked stairwell behind a key-card door. The lower floors hold the Architects' operational records — anything sensitive enough to never be filed by name.

buried_landing_one.name: First Landing
buried_landing_one.description: A wide platform of cracked Tartarian stone with a modern handrail bolted through it and a camera that may or may not be wired to anything. The stair behind you climbs north to reception; ahead it keeps dropping south, and the floor plan on the wall stops at this level.

buried_landing_two.name: Second Landing
buried_landing_two.description: Pumps west, records east, the cuts south, the stair back north. A laminated sign gives every direction a status code. The south corridor's code is not in the legend, and asking after it is itself a flag.

buried_pumps.name: The Pump Room
buried_pumps.description: Old Aetheric pumps churn the silt-water out of the lower floors, wired into a modern panel with a maintenance log nobody has signed since the handover. They have run for centuries. The only corridor runs back east to the junction.

buried_storage.name: Storage Halls
buried_storage.description: Tartarian crates re-labelled with barcodes, most rotted through, some intact — inventory the Architects took possession of rather than bought. The mud-glass containers in the back row are shelved under a category with no name on it. One corridor, back west to the junction.

buried_shallow_digs.name: The Shallow Digs
buried_shallow_digs.description: An active excavation the Architects run and do not describe. Tarpaulins, rope ladders, work lights on a generator. The cuts open into mud-glass strata where the Aetheric pulse is loud enough to hear with your teeth, which appears on the paperwork as an environmental factor. The way out is north, the way you came.

outpost_gate.name: The Vigil Door
outpost_gate.description: A stone arch wreathed in chains and lit by a single Giant-burnished lantern. The keeper inclines their head as you pass; speech is for the inner halls.

outpost_central.name: The Tomb-Lit Court
outpost_central.description: A round chamber lit only by tomb-lanterns, each named after a sleeping Giant. The map-stone in the middle marks where the Giants lie.

outpost_armory.name: The Vigil Forge
outpost_armory.description: Hammers and blades sized for a Giant's grip, smaller pieces for the rest of us. Irma sharpens what the Giants once carried; her own grandfather served them in the same forge.

outpost_messhall.name: The Vigil Refectory
outpost_messhall.description: Twelve narrow tables, twelve narrow benches. Halem cooks plain because the Servants eat plain; the meal is the prayer.

outpost_workshop.name: The Vigil Workshop
outpost_workshop.description: Tarek keeps the Giant-tomb torches lit and the Aether-pumps inside them serviced. Most of what he repairs has been working for a thousand years already.

outpost_quarters.name: The Vigil Cells
outpost_quarters.description: Narrow cells lit by single tomb-lanterns. The Servants sleep facing east, toward the Vault, even in death.

outpost_lab.name: The Tomb Records
outpost_lab.description: Giant-burial registers on stone tablets. Jorah keeps the count of which Giants sleep where, which have been desecrated, and which yet might be woken — the last list is in code.

outpost_relic_vault.name: The Reliquary of the Sleepers
outpost_relic_vault.description: Smaller artifacts from the Giants' burial — a ring, a tooth-pendant, the spike of a broken Giant-blade. Each is wrapped in lichen-silk and named by its keeper.

outpost_chapel.name: The Vigil Chamber
outpost_chapel.description: A meditation room facing the Vault. The Servants come here to keep the silent watch — eight hours, no speaking, no light but the tomb-lantern.

outpost_culvert_descent.name: The Vault Descent
outpost_culvert_descent.description: Stairs to the lower vigil-cells. The Servants who sit the deepest watch live below; you do not interrupt their silence without permission.

buried_landing_one.name: First Landing
buried_landing_one.description: A wide platform of cracked Tartarian stone under a single chain-hung lantern. The stair behind you climbs north to the Vigil Door; ahead it keeps dropping south. The Servants stop here to listen before going on, and so should you.

buried_landing_two.name: Second Landing
buried_landing_two.description: Pumps west, the offering stores east, the cuts south, the stair back north. The Servants hold that the south corridor runs toward something sleeping — which they take as a reason to go quietly, not as a reason not to go.

buried_pumps.name: The Pump Room
buried_pumps.description: Old Aetheric pumps draw the silt-water out of the lower vigil-cells. They have run for centuries, and the Servants have a name for their rhythm that they will not say aloud to a visitor. The only corridor runs back east to the junction.

buried_storage.name: Storage Halls
buried_storage.description: Tartarian crates left as offerings and never opened, most rotted through, some intact. The mud-glass containers in the back row are old enough that leaving them sealed has become the whole of the point. One corridor, back west to the junction.

buried_shallow_digs.name: The Shallow Digs
buried_shallow_digs.description: The deepest ground the Servants have opened, and they opened it slowly. Tarpaulins, rope ladders, tomb-lanterns in place of braziers. The cuts run into mud-glass strata where the Aetheric pulse is loud enough to hear with your teeth — which is precisely why the digging stopped here. The way out is north, the way you came.

outpost_gate.name: The Tool Threshold
outpost_gate.description: An open shop entry with a chalkboard for jobs taken and a rack of clean Aethercraft instruments. The foreman waves you to the slate without looking up.

outpost_central.name: The Plan Floor
outpost_central.description: A workshop floor of laid blueprints and stacked stone. The center stone has the Buried Cities' load-bearing tunnels chalked across it in three layers.

outpost_armory.name: The Forge Shrine
outpost_armory.description: Anvils on Aetheric isolators. Irma builds — she does not break. Each weapon she sets out is also a tool: a chisel that cuts mud-glass, a maul that lifts stone.

outpost_messhall.name: The Mess Bench
outpost_messhall.description: A workshop break-room with iron-leg tables and tin plates. Halem feeds whoever can hold a tool; the food is hot, plenty, and gone in an hour.

outpost_workshop.name: The Aethercraft Smithy
outpost_workshop.description: Tarek's home turf. Half-assembled Aethercraft engines, drone chassis, mud-glass casting molds — the Builders' real art happens at this bench.

outpost_quarters.name: The Crew Bunks
outpost_quarters.description: Sturdy bunks with tool-racks at the foot of each. Sawdust on the floor. The Builders sleep when the day's set work is mortared.

outpost_lab.name: The Drafting Office
outpost_lab.description: Plan-tables, slide-rules, and an Aethercraft compendium that fills two walls. Jorah is the senior planner; everything the Builders raise begins on her board.

outpost_relic_vault.name: The Materials Vault
outpost_relic_vault.description: Aether-shielded shelves of un-cast components, rare alloys, and a few prototype Aethercraft cores. Tagged by project, ready for assembly.

outpost_chapel.name: The Plan Room
outpost_chapel.description: A room with one drafting table and a single Aether-lamp. The Builders sit here when a structural problem refuses to yield on the workshop floor.

outpost_culvert_descent.name: The Foundation Descent
outpost_culvert_descent.description: Stairs to the structural cellars — load-bearing test pieces, the older Aethercraft cores still in service, the foundry pits.

buried_landing_one.name: First Landing
buried_landing_one.description: A wide platform of cracked Tartarian stone, chalked with arrows and a load rating in a foreman's hand. The stair behind you climbs north to the threshold; ahead it keeps dropping south, and the chalk stops where the surveys do.

buried_landing_two.name: Second Landing
buried_landing_two.description: Pumps west, materials east, the cuts south, the stair back north. Every direction carries a chalked figure beside it except south, which has a figure crossed out twice and re-chalked as a question mark.

buried_pumps.name: The Pump Room
buried_pumps.description: Old Aetheric pumps churn the silt-water out of the lower levels — pre-flood Aethercraft the Builders study and cannot reproduce. They have run for centuries. Two stand opened up with their panels laid out in order on a cloth. The only corridor runs back east to the junction.

buried_storage.name: Storage Halls
buried_storage.description: Tartarian crates stacked by weight rather than by contents, most rotted through, some intact. The mud-glass containers in the back row are test pieces nobody is willing to cut into. One corridor, back west to the junction.

buried_shallow_digs.name: The Shallow Digs
buried_shallow_digs.description: A working excavation, shored properly and lit properly, which is how you tell it from everyone else's. Tarpaulins, rope ladders, braziers set well back from the timbering. The cuts open into mud-glass strata where the Aetheric pulse is loud enough to hear with your teeth, and the shoring is doubled there. The way out is north, the way you came.

outpost_gate.name: The Stand-Down
outpost_gate.description: A wooden door under a hand-painted Tartarian flag, the symbol still wet. The cell coordinator marks your face against a photograph and lets you in.

outpost_central.name: The Rally Hall
outpost_central.description: A makeshift assembly room hung with mismatched Tartarian banners. The map at the center has every dig site marked with a date the Revivalists hope to publicize.

outpost_armory.name: The Cell Cache
outpost_armory.description: Wrapped weapons in oil-cloth ready for the next field dig. Irma asks no questions; if you're in this room, you're already on the list.

outpost_messhall.name: The Cell Mess
outpost_messhall.description: A folding-table common room hung with hand-printed flyers. Halem serves coffee in mismatched mugs and stew from a campaign pot — the food of a movement that hasn't won yet.

outpost_workshop.name: The Field Shop
outpost_workshop.description: Tools laid out for the next public dig. Tarek rebuilds donated equipment overnight so the cells can hand a working drone to a documentary crew at dawn.

outpost_quarters.name: The Cell Bunks
outpost_quarters.description: Mismatched mattresses on the floor, a curtain for privacy that nobody really uses. Cells sleep where they can; the work doesn't wait.

outpost_lab.name: The Evidence Room
outpost_lab.description: Stacked field-journals, photographs, recovered Tartarian fragments under glass. Jorah maintains the case files the Cell will publish when the world is ready to listen.

outpost_relic_vault.name: The Field Vault
outpost_relic_vault.description: Recovered artifacts waiting to be exhibited. Each crate is dated and stamped with a publication target — when the Cell believes the public is ready to see the contents.

outpost_chapel.name: The Cell Sanctum
outpost_chapel.description: A small room with a few folding chairs and a portrait of the founder. The Revivalists come here when the doubt is heavy and the cause is far.

outpost_culvert_descent.name: The Storage Descent
outpost_culvert_descent.description: Stairs to the cell's storage levels — film archives, banner stocks, the equipment the Revivalists keep ready for the next public action.

buried_landing_one.name: First Landing
buried_landing_one.description: A wide platform of cracked Tartarian stone with a banner half-unrolled against the wall to dry. The stair behind you climbs north to the door; ahead it keeps dropping south — the cell films down there and posts none of it.

buried_landing_two.name: Second Landing
buried_landing_two.description: Pumps west, the stock halls east, the cuts south, the stair back north. Someone has taped a hand-drawn map at eye height with the south corridor marked EVIDENCE and a date that keeps getting pushed back.

buried_pumps.name: The Pump Room
buried_pumps.description: Old Aetheric pumps churn the silt-water out of the lower levels: centuries of uninterrupted Tartarian machinery, which is the entire argument the Revivalists have been trying to get anyone to come and look at. The only corridor runs back east to the second landing.

buried_storage.name: Storage Halls
buried_storage.description: Tartarian crates shoved aside to make room for banner rolls, film cans and printed stacks. Most of the originals have rotted through; some are intact. The mud-glass containers in the back row get photographed monthly from the same angle. One corridor, back west to the second landing.

buried_shallow_digs.name: The Shallow Digs
buried_shallow_digs.description: The cell's own excavation, and the reason the cell exists. Tarpaulins, rope ladders, work lamps and a tripod left standing. The cuts open into mud-glass strata where the Aetheric pulse is loud enough to hear with your teeth — they have it on film, and not one outlet has run it. The way out is north, the way you came.
